newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt seeks 50,000 T U.S, French, Australian wheat.
newsitem.headline: Egypt seeks 50,000 T U.S, French, Australian wheat.

text.p: The government official in charge of commodities purchases said on Tuesday that Egypt was seeking 50,000 tonnes of U.S., French or Australian wheat for delivery from July 1 to July 20.

Samir Shakankiri, vice chairman of the General Authority for Supply Commodities (GASC), told Reuters the deadline for bids was 0900 local/0600 GMT on Wednesday, May 21, and the result of the tender would be announced later the same day.
He said the traders who are awarded the bid must submit a freight offer on Friday, May 30, to Martrans, the official Egyptian shipping company, and to GASC.
